title: 第17章 神兵有灵名为斩虚第18章 完成第一个主线任务
slug: 长生家族从十七岁成为家主开始
lines: “诸位朋友，看了这么久了，也该现身了吧。”
李行歌背着手，目光看向远处，冷哼了一声道。
话音落地。
伴随着一阵大笑声，数道气息强大的身影从远处飞掠而来，一众李家修士赶忙抽刀戒备。
见状。
来人赶忙道：“李家主，你们不要误会，我没有恶意，在下郑家郑灵君，李家主，有礼了。”
“郑灵君？”
听到这个名字，李行歌不由得一愣。
问道：“可是东江郑氏的家主？”
郑灵君笑答道：“正是在下。”
李行歌脸上露出了一丝笑容，让手下收起了刀。
拱手道：“李家李行歌，见过郑家主。”
东江郑氏的大名，白河县谁人不知？谁人不晓？
既然对方告诉他没有恶意，李行歌自然也不会傻到得罪人。
东江郑氏可是名副其实的白河县第一大族，不是现在的青枫李氏可以相提并论的。
九大家族之间，也分强弱。
东江郑氏，是毫无争议的第一。
看到李行歌的态度，郑灵君的脸上露出了一丝满意的笑容。
看来这位少年家主，少年老成，不是那种有点天赋就目中无人之辈。
再看其今日种种表现，郑灵君心中断定，此子，必成大事。
心中交好的心思愈发浓烈了。
“早就听闻李家主的大名，今日得见，果然名不虚传，以初入气血境的实力逆伐气血小成修士，今日过后，李家主之名必将威震八方！”
在这之前，李行歌虽有天才之名，但终究没有拿的出手的战绩，在一些老家伙眼中，依旧是一个小辈。
但今日一战，李行歌却硬撼一位老牌气血境修士，不落下风。
即使后者使用丹药强行提升实力，李行歌依旧能硬抗他一击，并抓住机会，将其斩杀。
这一切，已经足够证明李行歌的实力能比肩老一辈强者。
李行歌摆了摆手，连忙谦虚道：“说来惭愧，若非我家大长老出手相助，李某今天怕是危险了。”
说完，便转移了话题，向郑灵君介绍一旁的大长老道：“郑家主，这位便是我李家大长老。”
“李家李玄通，见过郑家主。”
大长老上前抱拳，语气恭敬的道。
相比李行歌，大长老更清楚，东江郑氏的家主在白河县意味着什么。
说句大逆不道的话，在白河县，大周朝廷的话可能都没郑家家主的话好使。
更别说，其本人还是一尊气血小成的强者。
哪怕李家的老家主李玄风在世，对上郑家家主，也要毕恭毕敬。
“玄通兄，客气了，倒是要恭喜玄通兄，晋升气血境。”
郑灵君一脸随和道。
同时心想，这李家的李玄通气血都衰败了，晋升气血境的成功率不足一成，但这不足一成的成功率，居然还让他成功了。
看来这李行歌果然是老祖口中的气运之子，一人得道，便是鸡犬都跟着升天。
若是自己能在李行歌没有成长起来之前登上这艘大船。
那未来，那遥不可及的先天之境，说不定也有望一观。
看到郑灵君看着自己那炙热的眼神，李行歌心中不禁打了个冷战，有些恶寒。
莫非这声名在外的郑家家主竟有些什么特殊爱好不成？
李行歌下意识的拉开了与郑灵君的距离。
李行歌眼神中的防备，郑灵君未有丝毫察觉。
他笑呵呵的道：“李家主，玄通长老，为祝贺你们覆灭了百年宿敌，在下特意准备了一份薄礼，还望你们不要嫌弃。”
content_en:
"My friends, after watching for so long, it's time to show up."
Li Xingge put his hands behind his back, looked into the distance, and snorted coldly.
The words fell to the ground.
Along with a burst of laughter, several figures with powerful auras flew over from a distance, and a group of Li family monks quickly drew their swords and were on guard.
See this.
The visitor hurriedly said: "Master Li, please don't misunderstand me. I don't mean any harm. I, Lord Zheng Ling of the Zheng family, Master Li, please be polite."
"Zheng Lingjun?"
Li Xingge couldn't help but be startled when he heard this name.
Asked: "But the head of the Zheng family in Dongjiang?"
Zheng Lingjun smiled and replied: "That's right."
A smile appeared on Li Xingge's face and he asked his men to put away their knives.
He cupped his hands and said, "Li Xingge of the Li family has met the head of the Zheng family."
Who in Baihe County knows the name of Dongjiang Zheng family? Who doesn't know?
Since the other party told him that there was no malice, Li Xingge would not be stupid enough to offend anyone.
The Dongjiang Zheng family is truly the largest family in Baihe County, and cannot be compared to the current Qingfeng Li family.
The nine major families are also divided into strong and weak ones.
The Zheng family of Dongjiang is the undisputed number one.
Seeing Li Xingge's attitude, Zheng Lingjun showed a satisfied smile on his face.
It seems that this young head of the family is young and mature, not the kind of arrogant person who has some talent.
Looking at his various performances today, Zheng Lingjun concluded that this son will achieve great things.
The thoughts of friendship became stronger in my heart.
"I have long heard of the name of the Li Family Master. Today I saw him, and his reputation is indeed well-deserved. With his strength, which has just entered the Qi and Blood Realm, he has defeated the young Qi and Blood cultivators. After today, the name of the Li Family Master will surely be powerful in all directions!"
Before this, although Li Xingge was known as a genius, he had no record of success. In the eyes of some old guys, he was still a junior.
But in today's battle, Li Xingge was able to defeat a veteran Qi and Blood Realm monk without losing.
Even if the latter used elixirs to forcibly increase his strength, Li Xingge could still resist his blow and seize the opportunity to kill him.
All this is enough to prove that Li Xingge's strength is comparable to that of the older generation.
Li Xingge waved his hand and said humbly: "I'm ashamed to say that, if my eldest elder hadn't helped, Li would have been in danger today."
After saying that, he changed the topic and introduced the elder beside him to Zheng Lingjun: "Master Zheng, this is the elder of my Li family."
"Li Xuantong of the Li family has met the head of the Zheng family."
The great elder stepped forward and clasped his fists, speaking respectfully.
Compared to Li Xingge, the elder knew better what being the head of the Dongjiang Zheng family meant in Baihe County.
To put it bluntly, in Baihe County, the words of the Zhou imperial court may not be as effective as those of the head of the Zheng family.
Not to mention, he himself is still a strong man with a small amount of Qi and blood.
Even if the old head of the Li family, Li Xuanfeng, is still alive, he must be respectful to the head of the Zheng family.
"Brother Xuantong, you're welcome, but I would like to congratulate Brother Xuantong for being promoted to the Qi and Blood Realm."
Zheng Lingjun said with an easygoing look.
At the same time, I thought to myself that Li Xuantong's Qi and blood of the Li family have declined, and the success rate of being promoted to the Qi and Blood realm is less than 10%, but this less than 10% success rate actually allowed him to succeed.
It seems that Li Xingge is indeed the son of luck mentioned by his ancestors. When one person attains enlightenment, even chickens and dogs will ascend to heaven.
If only I could board this big ship before Li Xingge grew up.
In the future, that distant innate realm may be possible to have a glimpse of.
Seeing Zheng Lingjun's hot eyes looking at him, Li Xingge couldn't help but shudder in his heart, feeling a little chilly.
Could it be that the famous head of the Zheng family has some special hobbies?
Li Xingge subconsciously distanced himself from Zheng Lingjun.
Zheng Lingjun didn't notice the defensiveness in Li Xingge's eyes at all.
He said with a smile: "The head of the Li family, Elder Xuantong, in order to congratulate you on destroying a centuries-old enemy, I have specially prepared a small gift. I hope you will not dislike it."
